profile.headline: Software Engineer at Glenair
profile.summary: I really love learning about real life applications of libraries and modules. It is amazing to see peoples lives change because of what I tell a computer to do. I strive to make the world a better and more efficient place through the power of my fingertips.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ERP/MRP software development
Front End ReactJS Development with Typescript. IIS automated deployment through Github Actions. API development with Python and Flask. Database management with MySQL.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Python (Programming Language) · YAML · TypeScript · MySQL · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Kanban development across Java and Python codebase. Full stack application development using Angular, Java, Python, PostGres, and AWS.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer I
positions.description: Bash scripting, linux server management, product support, Java development, and PostGrest administration.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Application support for a wide range of applications. Windows and Google active directory administration. Google apps scripts developed to more efficiently process internal company data.

positions.title: Coach
positions.description: Teaching young students the key concepts of learning object oriented coding through multiple different languages. Students learned simple projects from moving sprites across the screen as well as more challenging projects such as a visualization of a shortest path algorithm.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Assisting students in homework problems for classes ranged from introduction to fourth semester. Concepts covered include object oriented programming, algorithms, databases, agile development, and thorough documentation.
